name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with arms stretched forward and legs straight.
Squeeze your glutes and gently lift arms, chest and legs a few inches off the floor.
Hold for 2 seconds, keeping your eyes on the floor.
Lower slowly back to the mat.

common_mistakes.mistake: Cranking the head up to look forward
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the eyes on the floor just ahead of you

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting too high and jamming the lower back
common_mistakes.fix: Lift a few inches only and keep it smooth
